name: aria2
title: Aria2
description: Add and manage torrents in aria2c from magnet links or torrent files.
author: urbneng

commands.name: manage-torrents
commands.title: Manage Torrents
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: View, pause, resume, and remove downloading, seeding, and completed torrents.

commands.name: add-torrent
commands.title: Add Torrent
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: Add a magnet link, torrent URL, or torrent file to aria2c.

commands.name: set-magnet-handler
commands.title: Set Magnet Handler
commands.subtitle: Aria2
commands.description: Install a macOS helper that downloads clicked magnet links with aria2c to your download folder.

preferences.name: rpcHost
preferences.title: RPC Host
preferences.description: Host of the aria2 JSON-RPC server.

preferences.name: rpcPort
preferences.title: RPC Port
preferences.description: Port of the aria2 JSON-RPC server.

preferences.name: rpcSecret
preferences.title: RPC Secret
preferences.description: Value of aria2c --rpc-secret. Leave empty if RPC is unauthenticated.

preferences.name: downloadDir
preferences.title: Default Download Folder
preferences.description: Where new torrents are saved. Defaults to ~/Downloads if unset.

preferences.name: aria2Path
preferences.title: aria2c Path
preferences.description: Path to the aria2c binary. Leave empty to auto-detect Homebrew and PATH.

preferences.name: autoStart
preferences.title: Daemon
preferences.label: Start aria2c with RPC if it is not running
preferences.description: Launches a local aria2c daemon when the RPC endpoint cannot be reached.

preferences.name: seedRatio
preferences.title: Seed Ratio
preferences.description: Share ratio at which seeding stops for torrents this extension starts. 0 seeds forever. Default 1.0 matches aria2.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
